decisions.reason: As a close-to-core prescription product with a dedicated launch presence, it is still early to judge its full market value and the option value of keeping it open likely exceeds its carrying cost.

Because it is a distant-to-core generic in a highly competitive reimbursed market, early results are likely to reveal quickly whether it lacks sufficient value, making redeployment of resources more attractive.

This close-to-core cardiovascular tablet fits the firm's manufacturing and market capabilities, so despite price pressure typical of such products it is still worth keeping while uncertainty continues to resolve.
Although it was marketed less prominently, it supports the firm's aim to grow pharmacy-oriented self-care products and is relatively inexpensive to keep on the market as an option.
